findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "plan_conference_week" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Build conflict-aware day plans across November 2–6, 2026. Uses member preferences only when the caller already supplied member:read authorization.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, show_intro_messages · Private data: search_guide, get_job_context, plan_career_day · Public sink: set_job_status, show_intro_messages · Destructive: remove_saved_guide_item, delete_itinerary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, show_intro_messages · Private data: search_guide, get_job_context, plan_career_day · Public sink: set_job_status, show_intro_messages · Destructive: remove_saved_guide_item, delete_itinerary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
